text:
Jason_AE: Heads up - Keystone Retail POC warmup started, seeing intermittent 503s and bursts of 429s. Demo scheduled tomorrow, need rapid triage.
Sara_Sales: On it. Demo 16:00 PDT tomorrow, customer on trial credits. @Tyler_SE can you pull quick logs and repro?
Tyler_SE: Reproducing locally when concurrency >80. Minimal repro curl posted to the customer channel. Response includes x-redwood-reqid rq_12345 and x-redwood-swarm-node gpu07. Getting 503 or 429.
Maria_SRE: From infra, gpu07 entered degraded state after a GC event and throughput dropped ~40%. Autoscaler lagged and didn't shift traffic fast enough.
Maria_SRE: Short-term mitigation: move Keystone traffic to standby pool (gpu11,gpu12) and enable conservative batching and higher per-node concurrency.
Devon_Support: I can update routing table; need eng-oncall approval. Also the customer asked about pricing if we provide Dedicated nodes for demo.
Jason_AE: Approve routing change for demo stability. We'll sort pricing after.
ops-bot: @eng-oncall check: autoscaler at 86% ready. Routing change requested by Devon_Support.
Tyler_SE: Routing header we used: x-robin-priority: keystone-poc. Pushing snippet to #eng-platform.
Gwen_Security: One security note - Keystone SQ wants KMS/HSM specifics. We previously answered but they want appendix with HSM attestations. Link: https://redwood.sec/keystone/sq-response-v2.pdf
Ryan_Product: If this repeats, propose two-week Dedicated trial for demo stability. Finance said potential to approve a short reserved credit.
Maria_SRE: Immediate config: bump per-node concurrency on standby from 80->120 and disable preemptive GC on gpu11 for 2 hours.
Devon_Support: Implemented routing change and concurrency bump. Monitoring now.
Tyler_SE: Reran the same load - 10k hits, 200 OK for 99% requests, no 503s in last 5m.
Sara_Sales: Customer reports improvement, demo stands. :tada:
Gwen_Security: Jason please forward signed NDA so I can send KMS appendix to their security team.
Jason_AE: Sending NDA now.
ops-bot: Alert resolved - routing update succeeded, nodes stabilized.
Maria_SRE: Follow-ups: (1) autoscaler improvement to shift traffic faster on degraded nodes (ENG-8642), (2) add POC warmup traffic policy and docs (DOCS-459), (3) postmortem if recurrence.
Ryan_Product: I'll prepare pricing for a 2-week Dedicated trial and share by EOD.
Devon_Support: Added customer to extended trial credits pool and logged change.
Sara_Sales: Thanks everyone - great quick turnaround. If anything pops before 16:00 PDT ping this thread and I'll escalate.
Jason_AE: Demo confirmed 16:00 PDT. Closing swarm unless further issues.
Devon_Support: Saved logs and reqids: rq_12345, rq_12346, rq_12347.
Tyler_SE: Sending recap and repro steps to the customer channel now.
Gwen_Security: Will attach KMS appendix after NDA receipt.
Maria_SRE: Temporary guardrails remain for 2h, will revert at 19:30 PDT unless extended.
Sara_Sales: :thumbsup:
